s1: [warmly] Right now, your body is making millions of new cells, to help you grow and to repair any damage.
s3: But here's the bit people get wrong. [emphatically] The cell copies its DNA before mitosis even starts.
s6: [excited] Fibres pull the copies apart, one to each end, and the nucleus divides.
q: [playfully] Quick check. Does the cell copy its DNA before mitosis, or during it?
a: [warmly] Before. That's why both new cells get a full set.
